items.html: Ali Murtaza was signed up for the now defunct Indian Cricket League when he was just 17, having played all of three first-class matches, an indication of his potential. Three years later, once the ICL players had their ban lifted, he was snapped up by the Mumbai Indians to play in the IPL. ESPNcricinfo Staff
